factors.reason_template: Water is {value} C, inside preferred Pacific temperature range for pacific hake.
factors.value_notes: NOAA species and survey sources describe Pacific hake as pelagic/neritic and report depth distributions, but the reviewed evidence does not establish a numeric preferred surface-temperature interval. Bottom or midwater temperatures cannot validate the configured 6-15 °C SST range or 8-13 °C ideal. Keep values unchanged and mark needs_source.

factors.reason_template: Depth is {value} m, within prime Pacific depth zone for pacific hake.
factors.value_notes: NOAA's species record reports occurrence from 0-914 m, generally deeper than 229 m; survey data show 25-575 m, with 97.9% of occurrences between 50-500 m. This supports the configured 50-400 m shelf/slope range as a broad occurrence screen, but hake is pelagic and often well off bottom; the 52-395 m ideal is not a measured seafloor preference curve.
